result.title: Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
result.summary: Continuous diffusion models generate discrete data through stochastic dynamics in an embedding space. We consider jump diffusions that additionally reset coordinates to embeddings of categorical values. A coordinate's own corrupted state can make prediction easy, potentially reducing the pressure to learn dependencies between coordinates. We study leave-one-out (LOO) prediction, in which each coordinate is predicted from the corrupted states of the other coordinates. We show that, under stated assumptions, jump diffusions with complete coordinate resets and state-independent clocks preserve the prescribed marginals when reset destinations use exact LOO probabilities and the drift uses the full endpoint posterior. We further show that this drift can be constructed from LOO probabilities by analytic likelihood completion without additional network evaluations. We evaluate unrestricted, LOO, and completed predictions on Text8 and LM1B text generation and ZINC250k molecular graph generation. LOO-based variants improve key generation metrics over matched unrestricted controls on all three datasets. Controlled interventions assess reliance on local inputs and context, and we analyze the effect of analytic likelihood completion.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究跳扩散离散生成模型中的 leave-one-out（LOO）预测：每个坐标只依据其他坐标的加噪状态进行预测，避免自身腐蚀状态带来的捷径；给出保持规定边缘分布的条件，并提出无需额外网络评估的解析似然补全，在 Text8、LM1B 与 ZINC250k 上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 「屏蔽自身状态、强制依赖上下文」的 LOO 训练目标可能可供核查是否有助于缓解 LVR 中依赖局部旁路或视觉捷径而导致的信息坍缩；但研究对象为文本与分子的离散生成，与 VLM 推理的迁移尚未验证。
